design_rationales.design: shared causal backbone with softmax/diffusion heads
design_rationales.concrete_problem: discrete and continuous modalities otherwise require incompatible objectives and attention
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: reuse causal context computation and route only the output distribution by token type
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: VQ loses information; image-level diffusion changes attention and repeatedly executes the backbone

design_rationales.concrete_problem: continuous vectors cannot be represented by a finite softmax vocabulary without quantization
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: a lightweight conditional denoiser models each continuous token distribution
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: direct regression is cheaper but may under-model multimodality; diffusion adds sampling steps

design_rationales.design: four diffusion timesteps per backbone forward
design_rationales.concrete_problem: recomputing the large backbone for each sampled noise step is expensive
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: repeat latent/noise batches while reusing the causal condition
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: more samples reduce gradient variance but increase head compute and memory

design_rationales.concrete_problem: vanilla VAE channel variance collapse makes autoregressive exposure errors harmful
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: controlled latent perturbation trains the decoder/model to tolerate autoregressive deviations
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: larger variance can hurt reconstruction; deterministic AE lacks robustness noise

design_rationales.concrete_problem: mixed sequences need explicit modality/head boundaries
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: special tokens select when continuous generation begins and ends
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: external modality routing avoids tokens but reduces sequence-native interface

design_rationales.concrete_problem: DDPM token-head inference needs many denoising steps
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: a higher-order solver reduces head sampling iterations
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: fewer steps can reduce sample quality; other solvers are possible
